review_candidates.title: Head of Events
review_candidates.description: Company Overview Our client is a boutique luxury events and experiential agency specializing in the creation, planning and execution of high-end events and brand experiences for leading international and regional brands. The company has particular expertise in working with clients within the fashion, jewellery, luxury watches, beauty and premium lifestyle sectors , delivering bespoke experiences that combine creativity, design, production and exceptional guest experiences. The Dubai/Middle East operation works closely with international clients, regional stakeholders, creative teams, production partners and luxury brands. Position Overview The General Manager / Head of Events / Senior Project Manager will be responsible for leading the company's event operations in the Middle East, with a particular focus on Dubai and the UAE . The role will combine senior event management, project leadership, client relationship management, operational management and business development . The successful candidate will manage projects from the initial client brief and concept development through budgeting, planning, production, execution and post-event evaluation. This individual will also act as a senior representative of the company in the region, developing relationships with existing and prospective luxury clients and identifying opportunities to grow the Middle East business. Key Responsibilities 1. Event & Project Leadership Take overall responsibility for the planning and execution of luxury events and brand experiences. Manage projects from initial brief through concept, planning, production, execution and completion. Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets and resource requirements. Manage several projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional quality standards. Ensure all projects are delivered on time, within budget and according to client expectations. Identify potential project risks and establish appropriate contingency plans. Lead project meetings and maintain clear communication between all stakeholders. 2. Luxury Client Management Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior representatives of luxury brands. Act as the primary senior contact for key clients throughout the project lifecycle. Understand clients' brand positioning, objectives, guidelines and expectations. Lead client briefings, presentations, progress meetings and project reviews. Manage client expectations and proactively resolve issues. Develop long-term relationships that generate repeat business. Maintain a high level of discretion when dealing with VIPs, celebrities, senior executives and confidential product launches. 3. Business Development Identify new business opportunities within the Middle East luxury market. Develop relationships with fashion houses, jewellery brands, luxury watch companies, beauty brands and premium lifestyle businesses. Build and maintain a strong network of luxury industry contacts. Participate in new-business pitches and client presentations. Prepare and review proposals, presentations, budgets and commercial offers. Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships. Monitor market trends and emerging opportunities within the UAE and GCC. Contribute to the growth of the company's Middle East operation. 4. Event Production & Execution Oversee the planning and execution of: Luxury fashion events Jewellery launches Luxury watch launches Product launches VIP client events Gala dinners Brand activations Boutique and store openings Press and media events Influencer and celebrity events Private client experiences Corporate events Experiential marketing campaigns Pop-up events and installations International and regional brand experiences 5. Creative & Concept Development Work closely with creative teams to develop concepts that reflect the client's brand identity. Translate client briefs into creative and commercially viable event solutions. Collaborate with designers, set designers, production teams, entertainment agencies and technical specialists. Review creative proposals and ensure they are achievable within budget and timeline. Ensure all event elements reflect the premium positioning of the client's brand. Keep abreast of international trends in luxury events, fashion, design, hospitality and experiential marketing. 6. Budget & Commercial Management Prepare and manage project budgets. Review supplier quotations and negotiate commercial terms. Monitor project costs and profitability. Ensure projects remain within approved budgets. Identify opportunities for cost efficiencies without compromising quality. Manage supplier and production partner negotiations. Review project financial performance and provide regular updates to senior management. Support the commercial team with proposals and pricing. 7. Supplier & Partner Management Develop and maintain relationships with high-quality local and international suppliers. Manage production companies, contractors, venues, technical suppliers, designers and other event partners. Source and evaluate suppliers based on quality, reliability and commercial competitiveness. Negotiate supplier rates and contractual terms. Ensure suppliers meet agreed timelines and quality standards. Maintain a reliable network of event-production partners throughout the UAE and GCC. 8. Operations & Logistics Manage venue selection, site inspections and event logistics. Coordinate event setup, rehearsals, production and dismantling. Oversee guest management, hospitality, transportation and entertainment requirements. Coordinate event staffing and operational requirements. Ensure permits, venue approvals and other regulatory requirements are addressed. Develop contingency plans for operational and production risks. Ensure smooth execution on event days. 9. Team Leadership Lead and coordinate internal event and project teams. Allocate resources according to project requirements. Provide direction and support to project managers, event managers and coordinators. Ensure team members understand project objectives, deadlines and responsibilities. Monitor team performance and project delivery. Develop a collaborative, accountable and high-performance working environment. Build and maintain a network of experienced freelance event professionals where required. 10. Regional Management Support the development and growth of the company's Middle East operation. Represent the company professionally within the UAE luxury and events industry. Develop strategic relationships with key industry stakeholders. Monitor the competitive landscape and market opportunities. Provide management with regular updates on projects, business opportunities and market developments. Contribute to the development of the company's Middle East strategy. Additional qualifications in event management, luxury brand management, marketing or experiential marketing would be advantageous. Professional Experience 8–15+ years of experience in luxury events, experiential marketing, event production, creative agencies or a related environment. Proven experience managing high-end luxury events and brand experiences . Experience working with fashion, jewellery, luxury watches, beauty, hospitality or premium lifestyle brands . Strong UAE/Middle East market experience. Experience dealing with international brands and senior-level clients. Previous experience managing teams, suppliers and complex projects. Strong commercial and business-development exposure. The person should be capable of working at both strategic and operational levels . They should be comfortable meeting a CEO or Marketing Director of a global luxury brand in the morning, developing a project strategy in the afternoon and being hands-on with the production team when required. Candidates coming from luxury event agencies, experiential agencies, creative agencies, fashion houses, jewellery companies, luxury watch brands, premium hospitality or luxury retail would be highly relevant. Establish and monitor service measures, including case volumes, cycle times, service quality, compliance, employee experience and vendor performance. Use mobility data and insights to identify risks, capacity requirements and opportunities to improve service delivery. Provide regular reporting and operational insights to the Head of Total Rewards and Mobility and People Services leadership. Lead the implementation of mobility process, system and policy changes within Shared Services. Review service quality, resolve provider performance issues and support vendor reviews, contract discussions and cost-management initiatives. Monitor mobility expenditure and identify opportunities to improve value and control costs. Determine training requirements, share knowledge and address capability or performance gaps in a timely manner. Set clear performance expectations and hold team members accountable for service delivery, quality and compliance. Build team capability through coaching, cross-training, succession planning and structured knowledge transfer. Allocate work and manage capacity according to business priorities, case complexity and service risk. Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture that supports collaboration, wellbeing and continuous improvement. Shared Services Operations Establish a culture of flexibility and adaptability to varying business requirements and operating hours. Ensure the team complies with confidentiality and information-handling requirements relating to People activities. What can you bring to the team? Proven Global Mobility leadership experience, with a strong track record of managing and developing high-performing teams in a service delivery or specialist environment. Deep expertise in global mobility operations, including international assignments, immigration, taxation, payroll, relocation, and cross-border employment considerations. Strong knowledge of Australia, New Zealand, and Asia mobility frameworks, including immigration requirements, regulatory compliance, and mobility governance. Experience managing complex and escalated mobility cases across multiple jurisdictions while ensuring risk mitigation and operational compliance. Demonstrated project and change management capabilities, including process improvement, policy enhancements, and technology implementations within a global or shared services environment. Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively across global matrix organizations and senior leadership teams. Analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using reporting, service metrics, and insights to drive decision-making, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Self-starter with excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, capable of working independently, managing competing priorities, and delivering outcomes with integrity and resilience. Experience with HRIS, ATS, or Global Mobility platforms such as Workday and similar systems. Experience managing third-party mobility, immigration, or relocation vendors and service providers. About Us Aurecon is an advisory and engineering company, but not as you know it! For a start, our clients' ideas drive what we do. Drawing on our deep pool of expertise, we co-create innovative solutions with our clients to some of the world's most complex challenges. And through a range of unique creative processes and skills, we work to re-imagine, shape and design a better future. We listen deeply and intently, which helps us see opportunities, possibilities and potential that others can't. Want to know more? You can learn more about what it's like to work at Aurecon by visiting the careers section of our website. If you are intrigued or excited by what you have read, then we want to hear from you. Apply now!

Strong project or programme management experience, ideally within a complex global organisation. Proven ability to manage high-priority projects with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities and demanding timelines. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to influence across a matrix organisation and drive outcomes without direct authority. Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing complex dependencies, risks and issues. Experience managing vendors, CROs, external partners or other third parties. Strong risk, issue and dependency management skills. Ability to deliver to demanding deadlines while maintaining quality. Strong vendor and external partner management capability.
